title: Complete Fibonacci square-root records with residual and written proof dependencies
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED: Fibonacci's Practica geometriae supplies actual complete worked integer-root prose and owned numerical tables, rather than an invented short ledger. The bounded initial sequence on Boncompagni 1862 pp. 19-23 has 11 named inputs. The complete 864 record gives root 29 and remainder 23 through dependent decimal placement, doubling and subtraction; 960 gives root 30 and remainder 60, preserving the equality boundary. The 12345 record additionally writes a complete modulo-7 verification of root 111 and remainder 24. Primary full pages and manuscript ff. 11v-12v were actually viewed; public links, hashes, full 864/960 wording, explicit-versus-inferred value inventories and chapter boundaries are in research_registry/work_batches/ten_hours_20260915/ROOT_EXTRACTION_SOURCE_SUPPLY.md. The work is dated 1220 but the inspected witness is catalogued only to the fifteenth century. A hypothetical compact content projection and a global code remain unfrozen. No Voynich data was accessed; old fixed multiplication/division models remain closed.

design.mechanism: A possible complete-content reading would preserve one independently frozen historical square-root procedure across entire records: decimal digit placement, doubled preceding root, greatest admissible next digit, dependent residual updates, and final root/remainder identities. The source also supplies an explicitly written modular proof for 12345. Its actual prose and table have to determine the content contract before target inspection. A compact content projection is a new explicit model, not a claim that the source was a fixed-width ledger or that Latin is copied phonetically. One global finite numeral/operator serialization would then have to generate every written group across all records without per-record repairs. Source-written prerequisite root calls, estimated trial digits and explanatory/proof content must be accounted for; inferred intermediate numbers must not be mislabeled as literal historical fields. No such serialization or global key is supplied by this raw card.
design.unit: Whole independently bounded worked records, preserving the instruction passage and its owned numerical table as one semantic unit even across page turns. The source-side family is the 11 named integer-root examples on printed pp.19-23, before the explicit transition to fractional roots. All-source inclusion, prerequisite-call treatment and which examples require literal table reading must be frozen before any target choice; all 11 have not yet received diplomatic numeral validation.
design.contrast: GDT902 excluded the fixed complete Treviso multiplication table under its registered whole-word and decimal encodings. GDT909 excluded three or more equal-length whole-paragraph Euclidean division steps with four literal single-group fields and constant other columns. This candidate concerns nonlinear square-root digit/residual dependencies and actual written verification in a different complete historical source, not a change to those failed formats. IDEA000126 shares the broad complete-arithmetic-record architecture but lacked its exact astronomical canon. This card supplies nonastronomical source content while retaining the unresolved global meaning binding; neither source availability nor lexical duplicate results prove experimental novelty.
design.prediction: If a complete content projection and global serialization can be frozen independently, every declared residual update must agree with earlier input and root digits, and terminal r,s,n must satisfy n=r*r+s and 0<=s<=2*r. The strict inequality is not universal: the source's 960 case attains equality. Source-written modular proof values, when part of the frozen record class, must also agree with the same global numeral values; congruence alone is insufficient. A certain contradiction rejects that fixed whole-record reading. A complete independently designated subsequent record must be predicted without new key values, omitted fields or source-instance replacement. These are proposed falsifiers, not a claimed passed test or an eligible target endpoint.
design.scope: Potential reading of complete computational content, not unrestricted prose translation. Missing: independently frozen written content projection, source prerequisite-call policy, fully validated source numeral stream with explicit witness policy (the print has8171 where the native manuscript has8172), historical witness dating before 1450 if that cutoff is required, eligible target record ownership, global serialization and independent prediction case. The smallest next step is a bounded source-only ownership/serialization review, not decoder work. Retain as unreviewed raw supply; no reserve access, target access or reopening of fixed 902/909 models is licensed.

source_evidence.quote: Fibonacci's complete worked extraction of the integer square root of 864 is a real sustained instruction passage with an owned numerical table and dependent arithmetic end conditions. It supplies a distinct nonastronomical meaning candidate. It does not establish a Voynich numeral system, record boundary, or complete text encoding.
